$Comment: What a Cursed Geode holds when a player cracks it open. The geode's use runs the crack, which
hands this table out by id, so retuning the haul is an edit here and nowhere else.
Rolls are read one by one and each pays on its own: purple crystal fragments every time, and
an Epic Lantern Bomb now and then (Chance is a percent from 0 to 100). Pool is one draw from
the bag below, weighted against each other: the bomb tiers, Ectoplasm, or fire essence. Every
item goes where the cracking player's pickup settings send it, with the game's own pickup
notice, and whatever their bag cannot take drops at their feet.
A companion mod adds its own rolls to this table with a file of its own that names it in
ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change. The table pays whenever a geode is cracked, in
season or out, since the geode itself is an ordinary item once found.
Text names this table wherever a reward paying it is shown (Cracked Geode) and gives its hover a
line; the hover then lists what this table pays. HideInPreview keeps the rare Epic Lantern Bomb
out of that list, which then ends saying there are a few more rare finds; the roll pays the same.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Geode_Crack
